description:
Web Developer  
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Web Developer for a contract opportunity in Chandler, AZ. 
 

 Web Developer Job Details 
 

 Candidate will participate in a team to develop enterprise data driven web tool and batch processing code. 
 

 Web Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 Required skills include:  
 - .NET 4.x: C#, XML, SOA, SQL Server 2012 or higher, ASP.NET and JavaScript framework 
 - Experience with RESTful services with WCF/Web API JSON 
 - Experience in RDBMS design, database coding techniques and store procedures including EF and LINQ 
 - Experience in analyzing requirements, able to understand impact on existing systems and coding to meet the requirements 
 - Experience in designing, developing and maintaining enterprise class web based applications and services 
 

 Education: BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field.
 

 Web Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 Web Developer Assignment Length 
 

 3 Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
